_instructions: 3:4 enablement gate (ICE-04B). This template is VALIDATOR INPUT ONLY.

Run the studio format matrix on the delivery SHA: npm run harness:studio-format-matrix (needs CREATIVE_WORK_34_CREATION_ENABLED=true). Copy its meta.sha into webSha, workerSha and matrixSha — web and worker must run the same SHA.

A human reviewer judges every format against real artifacts: composition intact (no stretch, no crop surprise) and delivered bytes at the format dimensions. Fill reviewer names and artifactIds (creative-work / output ids).
Run the provider smoke under a separate paid-generation authorization; fill authorizedBy, executedAt and reportRef. The validator never runs paid calls.

Set status to 'completed' and run: npx tsx scripts/check-34-enablement-evidence.ts <this-file.json>. Enablement (setting CREATIVE_WORK_34_CREATION_ENABLED=true in web and worker) happens only after PASS.
